$description: Border and frame tokens — derived from retro_print and weathered_artifact aesthetics in visual_dna.json

thick.$description: Heavy rule; frame edges and ornamental borders

heavy.$description: Bold frame; masthead borders and cover accents

none.$description: Hard right-angle corners; strict print geometry

sm.$description: Subtle rounding; softens tag and badge elements

md.$description: Moderate rounding; card and panel corners

lg.$description: Rounded framing; photo captions and pull-quote boxes

pill.$description: Fully rounded; labels and price-tag shapes

dashed.$description: Dashed rule; editorial separation and cutlines

double.$description: Double rule; retro publication masthead border

frame_inner.$description: Inner margin between a page frame edge and its content; matches layout.zones.inner_margin in spacing.json

panel_inner.$description: Inner padding for content panels and callout boxes; aligns with the base spacing unit

tight.$description: Compact inner margin for dense elements such as tags and inline labels

ornate.$description: Decorative double-rule frame for feature spreads and covers

aged.$description: Worn-ink frame evoking vintage print material

accent.$description: High-contrast accent frame; pull-quotes and callout boxes

subtle.$description: Near-invisible hairline; image bleed and background separation
